greeting: Mirror Warden on comms. Stage 3: Mirror of the Soul. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Shattered Light. Objective drift gets teams buried.
The compass spun, laughed, and still pointed exactly where we needed to go.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Navigate the shifting maze.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Navigate the shifting maze; Conquer each party member's reflection trial; Reach the Crystal Chamber. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Navigate the Labyrinth of Reflections and face your inner truths. Immediate move: Navigate the shifting maze.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 3 resolved: Mirror of the Soul. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for The Crystal Awakens.
rumor: Crystal miners found reflections that move a beat before the original.
People keep repeating one clue from Mirror of the Soul: 'Reach the Crystal Chamber'.
I catalog omens by flavor now. Today tastes like burnt citrus and bad decisions.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn light in Prism reveals hidden seams in mirrored stone.
dialog.time_noon: Noon overcharges reflection grids. Angle your approach, do not rush centerline.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk doubles your silhouette count. Track teammate positions verbally.
dialog.time_night: Night turns crystal caverns into echo mazes. Keep line-of-sight discipline.

party_reactions.kade: Mirror Warden sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Mirror Warden accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Mirror Warden talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: Identify your lane and your fallback.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Good timing. We can still salvage this window.
relationship_dialog.friend: You know the drill. I trust your judgment.
